title: The Evolution of Discrimination in Online Markets: How the Rise in Anti-Asian Bias Affected Airbnb During the Pandemic
authors: Michael Luca; Elizaveta Pronkina; Michelangelo Rossi
eligible_reason: Single-date design. post = SNAPlab>=58 (the February 2020 Inside Airbnb snapshot) for every listing; treated = host with Asian-sounding name (prob>0.9) vs white host, a time-invariant group. reghdfe difrev i.treated i.treated#i.post i.post, absorb(listing_id i.nhood#i.SNAPlab i.nhood#c.trend) cluster(listing_id); columns add treated-specific linear trends and CEM weights; event study i.treated90_3##ib57.SNAPlab. One adoption date, so not staggered; neighborhood-specific linear trends in every main column.
design_notes: Stata 17. analysis/scripts/RUN_all.do -> RUN_empirical.do, RUN_DID_tables.do, RUN_event_study.do on Airbnb_data_NY_30percent.dta (NYC listings, Jan 2019 - Nov 2020 monthly snapshots).
data_provenance_note: README: 30% of monthly observations from each listing; ethnicity reported only as >0.9 probability indicators; geography removed or anonymized.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text). Common COVID onset date; not staggered.
